title: Long polling trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for long-polling trace events: one endpoint, the requests it has not answered yet, the server's event log and what the run cost.

endpoint.description: The endpoint being served, as the example named it (e.g. 'GET /api/messages').

style.description: Technical code for how the handler decides when to write the response; null on the comparison event.

now.description: The current tick. Time is discrete so a run is fully deterministic.

holdTicks.description: Held styles only: how many ticks a request may stay parked before the server answers empty.

cursor.description: Whether the client sends a `since` cursor, i.e. whether it can ask for what it missed.

pool.description: The container's worker threads for this endpoint.

busy.description: Workers currently held inside a blocking handler.

parked.description: Requests accepted and not answered yet.

inflight.description: Requests the server has accepted and deliberately not answered.

waited.description: Ticks it has been parked so far.

since.description: The cursor it was opened with.

holdsWorker.description: True when a worker thread is still blocked inside the handler.

log.description: The server's append-only event log: what happened, and whether it reached anyone.

seq.description: Sequence number — what a cursor points at.

label.description: What happened, in the example's own words.

deliveries.description: How many clients it has been written to.

missed.description: True when it fell into the gap between two polls and can never be asked for.

clients.description: The tabs talking to this endpoint and how far each one has read.

cursor.description: The highest seq this client has been given.

lastLatency.description: Ticks between an event and its delivery, for the last response.

timeline.description: One cell per elapsed tick, so the cost of a style is visible at a glance.

request.description: A request arrived in this tick.

empty.description: A response came back with nothing.

delivery.description: Something reached a client in this tick.

parked.description: A request was being held open during this tick.

busy.description: Worker threads blocked inside a handler in this tick.

stats.description: Running totals for the whole run — the bill for this style.

missed.description: Events that fell into a gap and never will.

refused.description: Requests that found no free worker thread.

avgLatency.description: Average ticks between an event and its delivery.

peakParked.description: Most requests held open at the same time.

workerTicks.description: Worker-ticks spent: one per handler invocation plus one per tick a handler stayed blocked.

comparison.description: Only on STYLES_COMPARED: the same timeline priced by each style.
